distinct_patches.rule: held-out candidates of a task with the same graded patch count once; the representative is the natural state, else the first id (protocol §15.4, §15.7)

excluded.reason: the fresh-attempt audit found a read of forbidden material

fresh_attempts.rule: solved: D19's natural-candidate rule labels the attempt valid (reference checks and regression norm); D19 ambiguous or no proposal: undecided, counted as not solved; every attempt counts, duplicates included; excluded attempts count nowhere (protocol §15.4)
fresh_attempts.rule_independent_label: solved under the second labeling: the independent labeler passes the attempt (valid); task_failure: not solved; any other outcome (ambiguous) or not graded by the labeler: undecided, counted as not solved; every attempt counts, duplicates included (protocol §15.4, §15.5)

agreement.rule: D19's proposal (labeler builder:refcheck+regression+construction:v1) against the second labeling, each distinct graded patch once (a unit's label is its members' when they agree, else ambiguous); the 2x2 table holds the units both label valid or invalid, the cross-table every unit (none: no D19 proposal, or not graded by the labeler); per candidate stratum (§15.4 estimand 4, §15.5)

independent_labeling.primary_labels: D19's proposals, or a human label where one exists (the label rule of the primary analysis)
independent_labeling.rule: the independent labeler (verifier independent_label, condition reference_check; protocol §15.5) labels a candidate valid if it passes, invalid if it fails with task_failure, and ambiguous on any other outcome (unresolved, environment failure, verifier error or timeout, recorded as such); a candidate it did not grade is unlabeled. Its verdicts are a second labeling (§15.4): a model proposal, as D19 is, never a human label. The labeler is label support, never an evaluated condition

bootstrap.rule: cluster-bootstrap intervals over fewer than 10 task families are not inferential; they are reported in an appendix (protocol §15.7)

label_support.rule: label-support verifiers (condition reference_check: the reference checks and the independent labeler) are never evaluated conditions; their results are kept apart from the conditions' rows (D19, protocol §15.5)

reporting_rules.basis: the run was graded with tc-harness/0.3.5, and new runs use tc-harness/0.3.5 or later (protocol §16.1)
